title: DR1 tells the person the certification answer is on the ITAHC; the frontend says only 'the health certificate'.

finding.frontend: Under 'What are the animals certified for?' the hint reads "You'll find this on the health certificate." — src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/additional-details/copy/copy.en.js:3-6. It names the document by its general description, and uses a contraction where the rest of the service does not.
finding.prototype: DR1's hint on the same question reads 'This information can be found on the ITAHC.' — app/views/additional-animal-details.html:53-55. It names the document the person is holding: the Intra Trade Animal Health Certificate, the same document DR1's upload-documents guidance calls the ITAHC.
finding.difference: Change the hint text on the certification-purpose question to DR1's wording. The hint below it, on the unweaned-animals question, is already word for word the same on both sides and needs no change. If the ITAHC abbreviation is expanded anywhere in the service the first time it is used, check that this page is not the first place a person meets it.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the DR1 certification question rendered with a hint that does not name the ITAHC.
finding.correction: Sound, and re-checked against the rendered pages rather than the page models, because these two hints were captured as null on both sides until a model bug was fixed and nobody had read them twice. Both strings are in the captured DOM: capture/html/frontend/fe-additional-details.html carries "You'll find this on the health certificate." and capture/html/prototype/dr1-additional-animal-details.html carries "This information can be found on the ITAHC.", and both are legible in the two screenshots. The claim that the unweaned hint needs no change is also confirmed the same way — 'These are animals that are still feeding from their mother.' appears in both files, character for character. The wider question the hints sit inside is settled too: the option list under the certification question is the same sixteen options in the same order on both sides, since DR1 reads one global list (app/data/certification-purposes.js) rather than the per-commodity certificationPurposeOptions its commodity data also holds, so the hint really is the only difference on that question.
